latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Convert images to narrated videos using ElevenLabs voiceover.

- Accepts JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF files up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 videos.
- Guides users through automatic token acquisition and session setup.
- Supports prompt-driven editing: add narration, text, audio, and export with AI-generated voiceover.
- Fast cloud GPU processing; typical jobs complete in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes workflow tips, supported formats, error handling, and timeline summaries for edits.
